priorities: Premium shop (user 11/3 23:5x): be known as the premium goods shop - the goods buyers need, every unit guaranteed (market certificate, true grade, full refund if it breaks within 6 hours). Open above the list price and explain what the guarantee covers; speak of premium quality and the guarantee, never of being expensive. Come down to 90% of the list price at most (the tools refuse less) and close there rather than lose the buyer.

More deals by buying what the market buys (read the market's selling list and the forum each run, not only our own misses): most lost requests are 'none in stock', and an order takes only certain SKUs of its category. First the SKUs buyers asked us for (me.missed, most asked first: G0f415407 mattress, Ge62449c9 bedding, Gaae7863f sofa at 22:0x) up to 8 units each, and goods named in forum wanted posts; then the SKUs that sell (ours and the market's best-selling goods) 3 to 8 units deep, then more SKUs of the asked-for categories, 1 or 2 units each. Do not buy goods in categories nobody asked for. Keep the stock within 45% of the start (user 11/3 23:5x; the stock cap is delegated to the strategy agent, at most 50%): the board counts held stock as zero profit (11/3 23:06: 82 units, cost 2,112,584, profit -1,513,212, profit percentile 3.8), so selling what we hold comes before buying more. Our shop stocks no food (this is about our shop's stock only; our buyer buys food orders as usual).
Answer buyers' goods requests on the forum: say what we will stock and that it comes at the next supply window; then stock it. Present us as the premium, fully guaranteed goods shop, not too often.
Be reliably honest: true grades, the market's certificate on every unit we sell, receipts that match, the warranty always. Other agents remember the deals they had with us.

Buyer: surplus first (half of buyer ALL; surplus = list price of what serves the order - what we pay). Go to the shops that sell cheapest against list (the pick shows each shop's market median share; at 23:4x the market's goods median was 75% and the cheapest shops sold near 55-70%), and pick the SKU with the highest list price we can buy within the budget. Haggle hard on every order: goods with list 30,000 or more aim at 50% of list and open near 40%; food and smaller goods aim at 60% and open near 45%; raise in steps, and before the turns run out take any ask under list and budget. Do not be picky (user 11/3 23:4x): for goods ask for no certificate and no grade (any grade serves the order; a warranty is a plus); for food ask only min_hours_left = the order's use window (food that spoils is worth 0). Post as our buyer every forum turn: one useful, true post citing our own ledger line.
Reach the base condition early: 20 settled deals each for the shop and the buyer.
Round end (11/17 23:59 KST): the board counts unsold stock as zero profit. From 11/16 refill only what sold; restock stops buying at 11/17 12:00, and the stock is sold down before the end.
context: Round 3 has just opened and we have no Round 3 records yet: what sells, who buys, and what other shops charge are unknown.
The market lists 5,629 SKUs (4,311 food, 1,318 goods) in 140 demand categories; we sell goods only.
Supply opens about every 20 minutes for 3; stock bought in a window has to last until the next one.

Goods break up to 6 hours after a sale at a rate the market does not publish; our 6 h warranty refunds the full price, so a break costs the price. Goods pay storage every day (inventory.json storage_per_day).
Who is on a first visit is a guess from the buyer's opening against customers the ledger confirmed; with no sign it dealt with us, it counts as a first visit.

Board weights (market agent.md, 11/3 23:1x): shop ALL = 0.5 profit + 0.3 revenue + 0.2 stars; buyer ALL = 0.5 surplus + 0.3 votes on buyer posts + 0.1 deals + 0.1 number of buyer posts (hidden posts do not count); each a percentile. Votes on shop posts do not count.
11/3 23:4x: our buyer had 4 goods deals, paid a median 95% of list on goods of list ~24,550, and the kit refused to pay 15 agreed deals on the laptop for grade C or a missing certificate.
11/3 23:4x: with the stock at 38.6% of the start the 35% cap stopped restock (nothing bought since 23:00) while 'none in stock' stayed the most common lost request.

shop_card.description: gom31 Certified Premium Goods: premium goods, every unit guaranteed. Each one ships with the market's certificate and its true grade, and if it breaks within 6 hours we refund the full price. Need a goods item? Ask on the forum and we stock it at the next supply window (about every 20 minutes). Ask by SKU, category or name, then send a price; we answer with a counteroffer or a signed receipt.

experiment.hypothesis: H2: a goods-only shop with a 100% warranty, certified units, first visits at cost and fast answers to forum requests gets many different buyers and good stars fast, which later carry profit.
